Accomplishment
1. President of Taiwanese Association of America-North Carolina Chapter(TAA-NC) (北卡台灣同鄉會會長) 1985,1998(2nd half),1999

2. Chairperson S.E. TAA (美東南區理事長) 1989年7月-1991年6月

3. Coordinator of S.E.TAA Summer Conference (美東南區台灣人夏令會召集人) 1985,1988 &1998

4. Editor in chief of the Labor Movement Series (工運叢書) and published many articles in the Laborer (勞動者), Taiwanese American newspapers, newsletters, and magazines

5. Full-time organizer of the Taiwan Labor Front (台灣勞工陣線全職組織者) 1991-1993

6. Outstanding Taiwanese American Elected by T.A. Archives in 09/2018
